info.title: SmoothTalker
info.description: A read-only library of conversation playbooks that helps an AI agent write smoother, kinder, more effective messages for its user: declining, apologising, negotiating, following up, delivering bad news, handling angry customers, DM replies for small businesses, and more. Every entry gives a structure, principles, ready-to-adapt examples at several tones, anti-patterns and what to do if the reply goes badly. All endpoints are plain GET requests to static JSON; no authentication. Two ways to use it. Index-first, the lightest: load /data/index.json (the index, about 45 KB) and the core entries 00-how-to-use, 01-principles, 02-tone-calibration and 03-anti-patterns, then fetch /data/entries/{id}.json for the one or two playbooks whose triggers and summary match the user's situation. Or load /data/all.json once a day and cache it, which needs the fewest requests. Always apply 00-how-to-use and 01-principles; if nothing matches cleanly, read 06-situation-router.

servers.description: Same files served raw from GitHub; use this if the public domain is blocked from your network

get.summary: Fetch the entire library in one request (about 348 KB). Use when each fetch is costly: load once a day, cache, and filter locally by triggers, tags and summary.

read_first.description: Entry ids to always apply before any playbook

get.summary: Recommended entry point (the index, about 45 KB): id, title, category, tags, triggers and summary for every playbook. Pick one or two, then fetch their bodies from /data/entries/{id}.json.
Fetch one playbook's full body by id (ids come from the index).
